item.title: Basketball: Leagues split Exceptional Seniors games at Albion HS
item.description: Seniors in Boys and Girls Basketball met at Albion High School on Friday for the annual Exceptional Seniors game between the Genesee Region and Orleans-Niagara leagues.In the boys' game, N-O won 133-76, and in the girls' game, GR won 79-40.Photos by Jennifer DiQuattro.
